solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Local poverty: not a cent

indicators.note: not means the following item is left out of the word for poverty

parts.note: indigence is extreme poverty
C is the standard abbreviation for a cent

explanation.surface: A complaint about local hardship: someone so poor they haven't a cent to their name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' is a noun here, a native, not an adjective. 'not' removes C from INDIGENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: An indigene is a native or original inhabitant, so a local person as a noun.

clue.text: Old French movement collecting silver leaves

indicators.note: collecting means the rebellion's name gathers the metal inside it

parts.note: the Fronde was a series of civil uprisings in 17th-century France
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A historical movement in France amassing silver coins as it goes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' looks like a verb (departs) but is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Frondage is foliage, a mass of fronds, so a collective word for leaves.

clue.text: Enter on list: 'Redcap's found one in fish'

indicators.note: in means the policeman and the article sit inside the fish

parts.note: an eel is a fish
a redcap is a British military policeman, an MP
an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: A list entry recording that a military policeman discovered something inside a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To empanel is to enrol names on a panel, especially a jury list.

clue.text: Prohibition announced for Scottish founder of dynasty

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition
quo is an old Scots form of quoth, meaning said or announced

explanation.surface: A ban on drink being proclaimed, set beside a Scottish dynastic founder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'announced' looks like a sound signal but gives QUO, a Scots word for 'said'.
explanation.definitionFit: In Macbeth the murdered thane is the legendary ancestor of the Stuart kings.

clue.text: That is to say that is right official

parts.note: viz is the abbreviation for videlicet, meaning namely or that is to say
ie is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A pedantic remark that a certain official is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A vizier was a high official or minister in Muslim states such as the Ottoman Empire.

clue.text: Setter's 21 at heart, putting them all in order

definitions.text: Setter's 21 at heart, putting them all in order

parts.words: Setter's 21 at heart, putting them all in order
parts.note: the middle of the 21-down answer runs A to Z, and the setter uses every letter of the alphabet in this grid, in alphabetical order across the entries

explanation.surface: The setter describing himself by the alphabet inside another answer and how he arranged the letters.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of 21-down is EAZL, which spans A to Z. Entries 6-across to 26-across hold A to M in order and 1-down to 21-down hold N to Z.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who composes sentences or puzzles using every letter of the alphabet is so called.

clue.text: Before start of evening pub returns flower and gets another to represent as a feature of life

definitions.text: represent as a feature of life

indicators.note: Before puts everything else ahead of the opening letter that follows

parts.note: PH is an abbreviation for public house

indicators.note: returns means the flower's name is written backwards

parts.note: the anemone is a flower
another flower: lis, as in fleur-de-lis, is a lily

indicators.note: start of takes the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: An evening pub crawl in which someone brings back a flower and fetches another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'start of' gives E, the opening of 'evening', which comes last. 'returns' turns ANEMONE into ENOMENA.
explanation.definitionFit: To phenomenalise is to treat or represent something as a phenomenon, an observable event of experience.

clue.text: Part of Henry V's rousing description of soccer?

definitions.meaning: a line from a rallying speech in Shakespeare's history play
soccer is a game played with the foot, so it is a game on foot

explanation.surface: A quiz question on Shakespeare's rousing speech turned to football.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakespeare's line actually comes from Henry V before Harfleur. The second sense punningly reads the phrase as a game played by foot.
explanation.definitionFit: The quotation is from the king's speech before Harfleur; read literally, football is a sport played afoot.

clue.text: Kindly and gracious spirit returns to occupy inner room

indicators.note: to occupy means the reversed drink goes inside the room

parts.note: in Scotland the ben is the inner room of a two-roomed cottage

indicators.note: returns means the drink's name is read backwards

parts.note: gin is an alcoholic spirit

explanation.surface: A kindly ghost comes back to haunt an inner room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gracious spirit' reads as one phrase, but 'gracious' belongs to the definition and 'spirit' is the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Benign means gentle, well-disposed and favourable in manner.

clue.text: Obtained a hundred and twenty-four sheets to put on end of bed

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a quire is a measure of paper, twenty-four (or twenty-five) sheets

indicators.note: end of takes the final letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Someone obtained lots of sheets to lay on the end of a bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheets' suggests bedding but means sheets of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Acquired is a past-tense synonym of obtained, got or gained.

clue.text: Loud noise is standard in Germany industry

definitions.meaning: Deutsches Institut für Normung, the German standards body whose initials label industrial standards

explanation.surface: A noisy complaint that racket is normal in German factories.
explanation.definitionFit: A din is a loud continuous noise; the German initials name its national industry standard.

clue.text: Barrels only used by gunmen

parts.note: sole means only, as in the sole survivor
RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners of the British Army

explanation.surface: Gun barrels used exclusively by armed men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barrels' suggests gun barrels but means casks.
explanation.definitionFit: A solera is a tiered system of casks used to blend and age sherry.

clue.text: Fake core ruined green nut

indicators.note: ruined means the letters of the two preceding words are wrecked and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A fake apple core spoils an unripe nut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green nut' looks like an unripe nut; it is a zealous environmentalist.
explanation.definitionFit: Green means environmentalist and nut means fanatic, so a fanatical environmentalist.

clue.text: Not all the money needed for enjoyment

indicators.note: Not all means the final letter of the word is left off

parts.note: a fund is a sum of money set aside

explanation.surface: Without enough money, you cannot have a good time.
explanation.definitionFit: Fun is amusement or pleasure, a direct synonym of enjoyment.

clue.text: Dutch spirit is always to follow senior officer

indicators.note: to follow means the word for always comes after the officer

parts.note: Gen is the abbreviation for General
ever means always, as in for ever

explanation.surface: A Dutch ghost that forever trails behind a high-ranking officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' suggests a ghost but is a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Genever is Dutch gin, the juniper-flavoured liquor from the Netherlands.

clue.text: Struggle for some viewers

indicators.note: some means only part of the following word is used, its opening letters

explanation.surface: Something proves hard going for a portion of the audience.
explanation.definitionFit: To vie is to compete or contend, to struggle against rivals.

clue.text: Irish spirit is cause of misery enveloping woman

indicators.note: enveloping means the trouble word wraps round the pronoun

parts.note: a bane is a source of persistent trouble
she is a pronoun standing for a woman

explanation.surface: An Irish ghost whose wailing torments a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: In Irish folklore a banshee is a female spirit whose wail foretells a death.

clue.text: Dread of woman on the windward side

parts.note: awe is reverential fear or dread
dread of something is awe at it, so 'of' becomes at
her is a pronoun standing for a woman

explanation.surface: Fear of a woman felt by someone standing upwind.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'dread of woman' becomes 'awe at her' when each word is swapped for an equivalent, with 'of' standing for 'at' as in being in awe at someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A nautical adverb meaning towards the side from which the wind blows, the weather side.

clue.text: Loge for five girls?

parts.note: a loge is a theatre box, and the five girls are the pop group the Spice Girls

explanation.surface: A theatre box reserved for a party of five young women.
explanation.definitionFit: A spice box holds kitchen spices; read whimsically it is a box for the five Spice Girls.

clue.text: To circulate on island, this will get you everywhere

indicators.note: on in a down clue means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: to pass something round is to circulate it
a key is a low island or reef, as in the Florida Keys

explanation.surface: Travelling round an island, a pass lets you go anywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A master key opens every lock in a building, so it lets the holder in everywhere.

clue.text: Agents in performance held by old Soviet police chief

indicators.note: held by means the performance sits inside the police chief's name

parts.note: Lavrentiy Beria headed Stalin's secret police, the NKVD
an act is a performance on stage

explanation.surface: Secret agents performing while detained by a feared Soviet security boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Agents' suggests spies, fitting Beria, but means agents of disease.
explanation.definitionFit: Bacteria are microbes that act as agents of infection, fermentation or decay.

clue.text: Plant note about misplaced zeal

indicators.note: about means the note's two letters go round the jumbled word

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the tonic sol-fa scale

indicators.note: misplaced means the letters of the word that follows are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A memo concerning enthusiasm directed at the wrong thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like a verb (to place something) but is the definition: a prickly herb. 'misplaced' signals the anagram; 'about' the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Teazle is a variant spelling of teasel, a prickly plant whose heads were used to raise cloth nap.

clue.text: Rose carpet of South America

parts.note: a rug is a small carpet
o' is a shortened form of of, as in o'clock

explanation.surface: A rose-coloured carpet from South America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rose' looks like a colour or a verb but is the flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosa rugosa is a hardy shrub species with wrinkled leaves and pink flowers.

clue.text: Prophet, priest and God

parts.note: Eli was the priest at Shiloh who raised Samuel
Jah is a name for God, as in Rastafarianism

explanation.surface: A list of three religious figures: prophet, priest and deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Elijah was the Old Testament prophet taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire.

clue.text: Ray's missing note in music

indicators.note: missing means the note is lost from the fish

parts.note: the skate is a fish of the ray family
te is the seventh note of the tonic sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone called Ray has dropped a note while playing music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray' looks like a man's name but is the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Ska is a Jamaican popular music style with an offbeat rhythm, a forerunner of reggae.

clue.text: Gentlemen concealed perverted goals

parts.note: hid is the past tense of hide, to conceal

indicators.note: perverted means the letters of the word for targets are twisted

explanation.surface: Gentlemen covering up corrupt ambitions.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidalgo is a Spanish nobleman of the lower rank, a gentleman by birth.

clue.text: Shudder about death with time coming to the fore

indicators.note: coming to the fore means the letter for time is shifted to the very front

parts.note: re means about or concerning
mort is an old word for death
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A shiver about mortality as time moves on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with time coming to the fore': T, for time, moves from the end of REMORT to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor is a trembling or quiver, the same as a shudder.

clue.text: Frenchwomen pool drink in NW town

parts.note: elles is French for they, of women
a mere is a lake or pool
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: French women by a pool having a drink in a north-western town.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an industrial town in Cheshire, north-west England, on the Manchester Ship Canal.
